title: Opening, birth and father's death in 1927
summary: Russell opens the session; Cottrell gives his name, 1911 birth on Robertson Street, and his father's death in 1927 when he was 16.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I'll make a note here that we're interviewing Mr. Louis Cottrell at 731 St. Peter Street, and the date is August 25th, 1961, and Ralph Collins is also present. Would you mind stating your full name, if you have a middle name? Yes, Louis Albert Cottrell.
Could you tell us just when you were born and what part of the city and all? March 7, 1911, right on Robertson between DeVayne and St. Philip. I think the address is 915.

On Robertson? On North Robertson. Naturally, everyone remembers your father. That is, the old timers that have told us, mentioned about his important part in music. Is there anything that you could add to your recollections when you were a boy? By the way, I don't even know when your father died. I don't know. We probably have the date someplace, but I forgot. He died on October 17, 1927. 27?
Yeah, he would have been 49. His next coming boy, which would have been December 25th.
So you were about 16 then? 16. Can you tell us if he ever helped you much in music? Had you started? When did you start in music? I started under my father. It was at the age of 10.
